title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Printing and Issuing the Decision on Amending the Several Provisions on Case Numbers of the People's Courts
keywords_en: Intellectual property; Cases concerning people's courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Decision on Amending the Several Provisions on Case Numbers of People's Courts

Fa [2018] No. 335

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; and all units of this Court:

In accordance with the needs of trial work, the Supreme People's Court has decided to adjust certain provisions of the Several Provisions on Case Numbers of People's Courts, and to determine the special adjudication codes for certain types of cases. These are now issued and shall come into effect on January 1, 2019.

Please promptly report any issues or circumstances discovered during implementation to the Supreme People's Court.

December 7, 2018

Decision on Amending the Several Provisions on Case Numbers of People's Courts

In accordance with the needs of trial work, the Several Provisions on Case Numbers of People's Courts are amended as follows:

1. Article 2 is amended to read: "The basic elements of a case number are the case acceptance year, the court code, the special adjudication code, the type code, and the case serial number.

The case acceptance year is the Gregorian calendar year in which the case is accepted, expressed in Arabic numerals.

The court code is the abbreviated identifier of the court handling the case, expressed in Chinese characters and Arabic numerals.

The special adjudication code is the abbreviation of the special adjudication category determined by the Supreme People's Court, expressed in one Chinese character.

The type code is the abbreviation of the case type, expressed in Chinese characters.

The case serial number is the sequential number of the case acceptance, expressed in Arabic numerals."

2. The first paragraph of Article 3 is amended to read: "The arrangement format for each basic element of the case number is: '(' + case acceptance year + ')' + court code + special adjudication code + type code + case serial number + 'No.'"

3. Item (3) of the second paragraph of Article 5 is amended to read: "(3) For the specialized intermediate courts under the high people's courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, including railway, maritime, intellectual property, oil field, forestry, and agricultural reclamation courts, as well as the cross-administrative-region intermediate courts under the high people's courts of provinces and autonomous regions, and the intermediate courts established corresponding to the people's courts for some county-level administrative divisions within a province (autonomous region), the numerical codes shall be determined as 71, 72, 73, 74, 75-80, 81-85, 87-95, and 96-99 respectively."

4. The first paragraph of Article 10 is amended to read: "Case serial numbers under the same special adjudication code and type code shall be arranged in sequential natural numbers according to the order of case acceptance within the same case acceptance year, except in the circumstances provided for in the second paragraph."

Special adjudication code for patent and other intellectual property cases

For cases tried by the people's courts as determined by the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Several Issues Concerning the Litigation Procedures for Patent and Other Intellectual Property Cases, the special adjudication code is "Zhi" (知).
